key_concepts: Water exists as solid ice, liquid water, and gas steam or water vapor
Water is a basic need for humans, plants, and animals
Evaporation is the phase change from liquid water to water vapor or gas
Heat from the sun can cause evaporation, such as drying wet clothes
Boiling water produces steam and demonstrates evaporation
Condensation is the phase change from water vapor or gas to liquid water
Condensation occurs when water vapor meets a cooler surface
The water cycle is the continuous movement of water on Earth
The water cycle has four main stages: evaporation, condensation, precipitation, and collec
Condensation forms clouds made of water droplets
Precipitation is liquid or solid water falling to Earth due to gravity
Collection stores precipitation on land or returns it to bodies of water
